jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role Context This new role comes as our customer base grows rapidly, driven in particular by deployments in private healthcare facilities. Its purpose is to ensure our customers get the most out of our solution and are fully satisfied with it. As Lead Customer Success, you will own customer usage and satisfaction, and manage our Customer Support team of two experienced people. This is a hands-on Lead role: you will manage the team while still spending a significant share of your time working directly on accounts. Lowongan Kerja Bank Mandiri Taspen. Bank ini memulai sejarahnya di Denpasar pada tanggal 23 Februari 1970 sebagai sebuah Maskapai Andil Indonesia (MAI) dengan nama Bank Pasar Sinar Harapan Bali. Pada tanggal 3 November 1992, badan hukum bank ini diubah menjadi Perseroan Terbatas (PT) dengan nama Bank Sinar Harapan Bali. Pada tanggal 10 Maret 1994, bank ini ditetapkan sebagai sebuah bank umum. Pada tahun 2005, terbit peraturan baru dari Bank Indonesia yang mewajibkan bank umum untuk memiliki modal inti setidaknya sebanyak Rp 80 miliar paling lambat pada tanggal 31 Desember 2007.
